assessments.reasoning: GNU FTP lines 62–70, bytes [2967,3586), identify who places the notice and which work it covers. The appendix at lines 282–299 instructs an author how to attach a notice and includes author placeholders. Its presence in the bare file does not supply the §0 link to a particular work.

GNU FTP lines 237–248, bytes [12672,13376), distinguish a numbered notice offering later versions from a notice omitting the number. A version-2-only notice meets neither condition for choosing another version.

limitations: The appendix illustrates wording a copyright holder can adopt. Establishing the choice for an identified work requires evidence of its own applicable notice.
reasoning: Section 0 connects the GPL to a work through the copyright holder's applicable notice. Section 9 gives the licensee the stated election when that work specifies version 2 and permits later versions. The eligible later versions are GNU GPL versions published by the FSF.
